cohort: The cohort consisted of adults born in Olmsted County, with 89 pairs of cases (meeting modified Rome III criteria for IBS) and age- and gender-matched controls included in the final analyses.
finding: Lower birth weight significantly increased the odds for adult Irritable Bowel Syndrome (OR = 1.54 [95% CI = (1.12, 2.08), p = 0.008]).
mod_finding: Delivery method was not associated with IBS status in this study, although it was only powered to detect large odds ratios.
birth_weight: Median birth weight was 3.35 kg (range: 1.96-5.24) for cases and 3.57 kg (range: 2.18-4.59) for controls.
